activity_detector: Wintun forwarded gameplay activity + process lifecycle
remote_endpoint_source: minimal EndpointGate using WFP ALE_AUTH_CONNECT scoped to Roblox AppId + UDP + gameplay port profile
routing_scope: exact learned /32 host only; multiple gameplay ports on the same host are valid
notes: Roblox gameplay routing uses UDP remote ports 49152-65535 as a strong first-flow discriminator. UDP such as :3478 is excluded before endpoint gating. RelayPreferred installs one exact /32 from an eligible gameplay-port WFP event before releasing the gate, then accepts flow-scoped reverse proof for any same-host flow actually forwarded by Wintun. A route lock lasts for one gameplay cycle; after a process/server gameplay boundary old route evidence is cleared and WFP is re-armed. Client quality telemetry uses GLO tunnel RTT and gameplay sequence counters rather than calling relay RTT game-server ping.
